Application.description: This class represents the Live application.

Chain.description: This class represents a group device chain in Live.

ChainMixerDevice:0.description: This class represents a Chain's Mixer Device in Live\\, which gives you access to the Volume\\, Panning\\, and Send properties of a Chain.

Clip.description: This class represents a Clip in Live. It can be either an Audio Clip or a MIDI Clip\\, in an Arrangement or the Session\\, depending on the Track (Slot) it lives in.

ClipSlot.description: This class represents an entry in Lives Session view matrix.

CompressorDevice:Compressor2.description: This class represents a Compressor device.

Device:AutoFilter2.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.

Device:ChannelEq.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:ChannelEq.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 0

Device:DrumBuss.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:DrumBuss.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 4

Device:GlueCompressor.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:GlueCompressor.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 3

Device:Limiter.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:Limiter.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 5

Device:MidiArpeggiator.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.

Device:Operator.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.

Device:Redux2.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:Redux2.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 1

Device:Reverb.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.

Device:Saturator.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Device:Saturator.path: live_set tracks 9 devices 0 return_chains 0 devices 0 chains 0 devices 2

Device:StereoGain.description: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.

DeviceIO.description: This class represents a specific input or output bus of a device.

DeviceParameter.description: This class represents a (automatable) parameter within a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device.

DriftDevice:Drift.description: This class represents a Drift device.

DrumChain.description: This class represents a drum group device chain in Live.

DrumPad.description: This class represents a drum group device pad in Live.

Eq8Device:Eq8.description: This class represents an Eq8 device.

Groove.description: This class represents a groove in Live.

GroovePool.description: This class represents the groove pool in Live.

HybridReverbDevice:Hybrid.description: This class represents a Hybrid Reverb device.

LiveBridge.description: The control surface Live instantiates.      Live calls :meth:`__init__` once at startup (and again after a reload)\\,     :meth:`update_display` every ~100 ms and :meth:`disconnect` on shutdown.     Everything else happens on the socket threads.

LooperDevice:Looper.description: This class represents a Looper device.

MaxDevice:MxDeviceAudioEffect.description: This class represents a Max for Live device.

MeldDevice:InstrumentMeld.description: This class represents a Meld device.

MixerDevice:0.description: This class represents a Mixer Device in Live\\, which gives you access to the Volume and Panning properties of a Track.

PluginDevice:PluginDevice.description: This class represents a plugin device.

RackDevice:AudioEffectGroupDevice.description: This class represents a Rack device.

RackDevice:DrumGroupDevice.description: This class represents a Rack device.

RackDevice:InstrumentGroupDevice.description: This class represents a Rack device.

RoarDevice:Roar.description: This class represents a Roar device.

Sample.description: This class represents a sample file loaded into a Simpler instance.

Scene.description: This class represents an series of ClipSlots in Lives Sessionview matrix.

SimplerDevice:OriginalSimpler.description: This class represents a Simpler device.

Song.description: This class represents a Live set.

SpectralResonatorDevice:Transmute.description: This class represents a Spectral Resonator device.

Track.description: This class represents a track in Live. It can be either an Audio  track\\, a MIDI Track\\, a Return Track or the Main track. The Main  Track and at least one Audio or MIDI track will be always present. Return Tracks are optional.

View.description: This class represents the view aspects of the Live application.

WavetableDevice:InstrumentVector.description: This class represents a Wavetable device.
